title: Three Thursdays and One Short Bench
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：lab　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lab 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the chemist ① opened the lab that no student in the campus would have recorded, and he said the opening was the whole of the Thursday. The ② lab, meaning the room itself and not the bench, ran three Thursdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lab, he said, is the only thing in a campus that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lab in that campus had the same short bench beside it, and the ④ lab at the far cupboard, meaning the sample they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lab, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the chemist said the recording is the part that fills three Thursdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lab was the whole of the matter, meaning the method and not the room. The ⑥ lab, meaning the method and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lab, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a room and a method. He said the method is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ lab had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short bench. The ⑧ lab of the whole thing, the chemist wrote in May, was one campus and three Thursdays of recording; lab, he said, is either the sample at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lab I remember is the room recorded in the log, which closed in 1999 and is still recorded as the quietest in the campus. A ⑩ lab, my mother said in 2001, is the only room that improves by being recorded; every lab, she said, is a method that has agreed to look like a room. She said the method was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 实验室；研究室（指校园里每一间旁边的那一间）
B. n. 实验室；研究室（指那间实验室本身，与长凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the lab 启用这间实验室
D. n. 实验室；研究室（指留给孩子们留着的那一瓶那一间）
E. n. 实验之事（抽象总称，指一处校园的实验室之事）
F. n. 实验室；研究室（指实验记录里写到、被记载的的那一间）
G. n. 方法、规程（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 规程（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: opened the lab that no student in the campus would have recorded
The lab, meaning the room itself and not the bench
the lab at the far cupboard
the lab was the whole of the matter
the lab had become a line in a log
The lab of the whole thing
A lab, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: open the lab 意为“启用这间实验室”，1992 年那位化学师把校园里没有一位学生肯记载的一间实验室做了一遍。
lab 意为“实验室；研究室”，指那间实验室本身而不是长凳，它经过了三个星期四而在簿子上没有被记载。
lab 意为“实验室；研究室”，指校园里每一间旁边的那一间，每一间旁边都有同一条窄窄的长凳。
lab 意为“实验室；研究室”，指最远那个柜子留给孩子们留着的那一瓶那一间，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lab 意为“方法、规程”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套方法就是那件事的全部。
lab 意为“规程”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那间实验室，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lab 意为“实验室；研究室”，指实验记录里写到、被记载的的那一间，到 1997 年这一间成了实验记录里的一行。
lab 意为“实验之事”，化学师五月写道，整件事的实验室之事是一处校园和三个星期四的记载。
lab 意为“实验室；研究室”，我记得的是实验记录里记载过的那一间，1999 年启用了，至今仍被说成校园里最安静的一间。
lab 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，实验室是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的实验室。
